weeks.title: Frame the problem
weeks.deliverable: Project topic, goals, and role table
activities: Introductions and team first orientation
Voice UX and Realtime fundamentals
Agree the problem, goals, and initial responsibilities

weeks.title: Design the conversation
activities: Define the target user and physical task
Map the conversation journey
Document edge cases and recovery paths

weeks.title: Build the voice loop
activities: Connect the Realtime API after verifying current documentation
Implement speech input and output
Explore turn-taking, interruptions, and event logging

weeks.title: Give the agent tools
weeks.deliverable: At least one core tool integrated
activities: Choose a tool that serves the core task
Implement tool calling and permissions
Handle tool failure and unexpected responses

weeks.title: Test what matters
activities: Define test scenarios, measures, and success criteria
Test latency, recognition errors, interruptions, and context retention
Record observations and prioritize improvements

weeks.title: Bring it together
activities: Integrate voice UI, agent features, and screen interface
Verify the end-to-end core user scenario
Document remaining limitations

weeks.title: Make the work legible
activities: Organize the repository and write development documentation
Prepare presentation and demo materials
Connect report claims to archived evidence

weeks.title: Share and reflect
weeks.deliverable: Final code, docs, slides, and demo video
activities: Run the team final results-sharing meeting
Check the end-to-end demo and collect peer feedback
Record individual outputs and reflections; rehearse and make final fixes

report.title: Executive summary
report.guidance: State the problem, target user, final scope, main outcomes, and current limitations.

report.title: Problem & research questions
report.guidance: Describe the hands-busy scenario, user need, hypotheses, and success criteria.

report.title: Agent & demo
report.guidance: Link the working demo, source code, demonstration video, and setup instructions. Explain what the agent actually does.

report.title: Design & architecture
report.guidance: Explain the voice loop, tool calls, handoffs if used, guardrails, state, and optional visual context. Include decisions and tradeoffs.

report.title: Development & technical insights
report.guidance: Document how API and Codex supported the work, obstacles, solutions, alternatives, and verification.

report.title: Evaluation & improvement
report.guidance: Record protocol, scenarios, participant handling, measured results, baselines, observed failures, and improvements. Separate observations from claims.

report.title: Learning journey
report.guidance: Synthesize weekly activities and show how the problem, design, and implementation changed over the program.

report.title: Individual work & reflections
report.guidance: Include each contributor’s approved name or alias, role, linked output, and reflection. Distinguish meeting attendance from program completion.

report.title: Limitations & next steps
report.guidance: Discuss unresolved problems, research limitations, deferred features, and prioritized future work.

report.title: Artifacts & references
report.guidance: Collect the final code, README, technical docs, presentation, demo video, approved photos, evidence index, and external references.
